document.abstract: The SMPTE New England Section held its annual NAB wrap-up meeting on Wednesday, 24 April, at WGBH (PBS) in Boston, MA, with a distinguished panel representing various aspects of the industry. The Section wishes to thank Emeric Feldmar, director of engineering, for hosting and producing a full studio recording of the event. Eighty-two members and guests were in attendance and interacted with the five panelists: John Rule, Rule Boston Camera; Stacey Decker, CTO WGBH; Phil Ozek, moderator; Tim MacArthur, TRF-Emerson College; Gerry Field, American Public Television; and Robert Lamm, Belmont Media.
